♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 TAWM LAWM! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions nrog **Your script** thiab **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, thiab **Flex Studio (Beta)** uas rub tawm ua ntej thiab nug koj ua ntej nws nruab.

*(Nruab rau saum koj qhov version tam sim no thiab rov qhib After Effects ib zaug.)*

♦️ **Tshiab: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Qhov layout **Map desk**, nrhiav qhov chaw yam tsis siv internet, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route thiab ntau ntxiv), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, cov style daim ntawv qhia chaw pub dawb thiab **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Nws cov cuab yeej ntxiv (live sync, style, label, 3D, Finalize) tam sim no thauj tau tiag tiag hauv After Effects.

♦️ **Tshiab hauv AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, siv Flex AI credits) yog lub engine uas peb pom zoo, xaiv ib zaug rau txhua tus. Xaiv Whisper dua los ua lus piav dawb ntawm koj lub computer (Translate To xav tau Whisper). Thaum server tsis khoom, nws qhia koj qhov chaw nyob hauv kab tos.
* **Your script**: cov lus piav siv koj daim ntawv script txoj kev sau thiab cov lus txhua qhov uas koj hais cov lus ntawd.
* Tso tawm ua **Editable template**: cov lus piav ua cov template layer uas koj hloov tau style hauv Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Tsis tau xaiv dab tsi thiab Source media khoob? Nws yuav muab **tag nrho composition** rau koj. Tib lub suab rov siv nws daim transcript.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** rub tawm, ces nug **Install / Not now**.
* Lub app (2.0.0-beta.2): cov workspace **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, cov yuam sij cuab yeej zoo li hauv After Effects, clips qhib tam sim ntawd, thiab OPEN siv tau rau precomps thiab adjustment layers.

♦️ **Kho lawm**
* Cov theme effects uas ploj ntawm ntau lub Windows PC rov qab los lawm (sib dua thaum Windows cov animation effects raug kaw).

♦️ **Qhov chaw nyob (xaiv tau) rau kev tiv thaiv licence**
* Nug ib zaug xwb, koj xaiv tau: nias **No thanks** los txhua yam tseem ua haujlwm li qub. Hloov tau hauv **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Khaws 12 lub hlis, yeej tsis muag, thiab yeej tsis qhia rau leej twg tshwj tsis yog thaum txoj cai yuam kom qhia.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 TAWM LAWM! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack tsiv mus rau hauv AutoCaptions** nrog style rau txhua lo lus, layouts, kev txav thiab suab. **UN-NEST** thiab blend modes ua haujlwm rau Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** tsuas nias ib zaug xwb, thiab **Flex Studio (Beta)** qhib koj daim clip ncaj qha ntawm lub panel.

*(Nruab rau saum koj qhov version tam sim no thiab rov qhib Premiere Pro ib zaug.)*

♦️ **Tshiab: Cov lus piav txav tau hauv AutoCaptions**
* **Style rau lo lus**: muab rau txhua lo lus nws cov xim, font thiab finish Flat, Shine lossis Glow.
* **Layout rau kab**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside thiab Line.
* **Kev txav rau txhua lo lus** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake thiab ntau ntxiv) nrog preview, ntxiv rau cov suab **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Cov style lo lus thiab kev txav xav tau qhov tso tawm **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, siv Flex AI credits) tam sim no yog lub engine uas peb pom zoo, xaiv ib zaug rau txhua tus; xaiv ib lub Whisper engine los ua lus piav dawb yam tsis siv internet.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): cov lus piav siv cov lus hauv koj daim script qhov twg koj hais cov lus ntawd.
* Thaum tsis tau xaiv dab tsi (daim Source card khoob), nws yuav muab **tag nrho timeline**; cov lus piav raug khaws ze koj qhov project.

♦️ **Tshiab: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** taug qab daim clip hauv lub app; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** xa qhov track rov qab. Tsis tau nruab? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** rub nws tawm, ces nug **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Hloov lawm**
* **AUTO CUT** tshuaj xyuas daim clip uas xaiv thiab txiav hauv ib zaug nias. **Retakes** ntes cov kab lus uas rov pib hais dua.
* **Audio Studio** tam sim no muaj 6 lub sub-tab. **Library** nyob hauv Nest Saver lawm.

♦️ **Kho lawm**
* **UN-NEST** rau Premiere 26.5 (yav tas los tsis kam txais txhua lub nest), thiab blend modes zoo li Screen uas rov mus rau Normal (Premiere ua lus Askiv).
* Lub chip liab **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, Caption Stack qhov preview dub, thiab cov theme effects uas ploj ntawm ntau lub Windows PC.

♦️ **Qhov chaw nyob (xaiv tau) rau kev tiv thaiv licence**
* Nug ib zaug xwb, koj xaiv tau: nias **No thanks** los txhua yam tseem ua haujlwm li qub. Hloov tau hauv **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Khaws 12 lub hlis, yeej tsis muag, thiab yeej tsis qhia rau leej twg tshwj tsis yog thaum txoj cai yuam kom qhia.
